tasks.title: gpu_input.py: the pure GPU-or-number rule, with label and match helpers moved from main.py
acceptance: THE SYSTEM SHALL provide `src/vramsherpa/gpu_input.py`, importing nothing from `main.py` and needing no session, with `gpu_option_label(gpu)`, `normalize_for_match(text)`, `exact_gpu_match(text, gpus)`, `parse_box_number(text)` and `decide_box(text, gpus)` returning a frozen dataclass `BoxDecision(kind, gpu, vram_text)` whose `kind` is one of `blank`, `gpu`, `vram`, `search` (ADR-0011 point 1).

THE SYSTEM SHALL move `_gpu_option_label` and `_normalize_for_match` out of `main.py`; `main.py` imports the new names so there is one definition of a GPU label and of "case-insensitive, whitespace collapsed" (ADR-0011).

WHEN `exact_gpu_match` is given text, THE SYSTEM SHALL return the GPU when exactly one GPU's full label, `<vendor> <name>` or `<name>` equals the normalised text, else `None`; `_resolve_available_vram` SHALL call it in place of its inline exact-match loop (R-003).

WHEN `parse_box_number` is given text, THE SYSTEM SHALL strip leading and trailing whitespace and return the numeric part as typed when the whole text matches `re.fullmatch(r"([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)(?:\s*gb)?", text, re.IGNORECASE)`, else `None`: `12`, `12 GB`, `12gb`, `12.5 GB` (`12.5`), `24GB`, `0`, `0.0` (`0.0`), `  12  ` and `12  GB` are box numbers; `12 G`, `12 GiB`, `12,5`, `.5`, `-4`, `12 GB VRAM`, `RTX 3060 12GB`, `１２` (full-width digits), `` and `GB` are not (R-083 "Box number", ADR-0011).

WHEN `decide_box` runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL decide in this order: blank or whitespace-only text is `blank`; an exact GPU is `gpu` (an exact label wins even if it would also parse as a number); a box number is `vram` with `vram_text` set; anything else is `search` (R-083 "How the box decides", Q-14).
THE SYSTEM SHALL provide `tests/test_gpu_input.py` covering every example above with plain stub objects that have `vendor`, `name` and `vram_gb` (no database).
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT change any page's behaviour in this task: every existing test passes unchanged, and `/results?gpu_search=8GB` still behaves as before until T-024.

THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, catalog validation (`python tools/validate_catalog.py --data-dir data --config tools/catalog_sources.yaml`) and `pytest` passing, with no network access and no real database (rule 19).
tasks.notes: UI: no. Pure refactor plus a new unit-tested module; about 60 lines. Use `[0-9]`, not `\d` (Python's `\d` matches other scripts' digits). No file under `src/vramsherpa/static/` changes, so no `ASSET_VERSION` bump (rule 21). `ESTIMATION_POLICY_VERSION` unchanged (rule 16).

tasks.title: /results reads a box number in gpu_search as VRAM, and the summary carries data-box-vram
acceptance: WHEN `_results_page_context` runs with `gpu_id` and `vram_gb` each absent or blank and `gpu_search` non-blank, THE SYSTEM SHALL call `decide_box` once; for `vram` it SHALL set `vram_gb` to `vram_text` and `gpu_search` to `None` before `vram_gb` is parsed, so every results path (full page, `/results/partials/content`, `summary`, `list`) renders what `/results?vram_gb=<n>` renders (ADR-0011 point 2).
WHEN `/results?gpu_search=12%20GB` loads, THE SYSTEM SHALL show `Manual VRAM (12 GB)`, `value="12"` on `#vram_gb`, an empty `#gpu_search`, no GPU search message and no default note (R-003).

WHEN `gpu_search` is `12.5gb`, `8GB` or `24`, THE SYSTEM SHALL show `Manual VRAM (12.5 GB)`, `Manual VRAM (8 GB)` (not `NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti (8GB) (8.0 GB)`) and `Manual VRAM (24 GB)` (no "matched multiple entries") respectively (R-003, Q-14).

WHEN `gpu_search` is `0`, `0 GB` or `0.0`, THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with the same R-008 inline error, 8 GB and default note that `/results?vram_gb=0` shows, and no GPU search message (R-003, Q-15).
WHEN `gpu_search` is `nvidia geforce rtx 4090 (24.0 gb)` or `GeForce RTX 4090`, THE SYSTEM SHALL show `NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 (24.0 GB)` as the hardware (R-083).

WHEN `gpu_search` is `RTX`, `RTX 3060 12GB` or `Quadro XYZ`, THE SYSTEM SHALL show R-003's messages word for word: the "matched multiple entries" message at 8 GB, `GPU "RTX 3060 12GB" was not found. Using 12 GB inferred from your input.`, and `GPU "Quadro XYZ" was not found. Select a listed GPU or enter VRAM manually.` at 8 GB (R-003, R-078).

WHEN a box number reaches `_resolve_available_vram`'s search branch another way (for example `/results?gpu_id=no_such_gpu&gpu_search=12` or `/results?vram_gb=abc&gpu_search=12`), THE SYSTEM SHALL use it as available VRAM with no GPU search message, and for a box number of 0 use 8 GB with no GPU search message; contains-match and the GB hint SHALL run only for `search` text (ADR-0011 point 3).
WHEN `vram_gb` is non-blank, THE SYSTEM SHALL keep today's precedence: `/results?vram_gb=24&gpu_search=12` computes for 24 GB (ADR-0011 consequences, Gate 2).

WHEN the hardware came from a box number (including 0), THE SYSTEM SHALL render `data-box-vram="<vram_text>"` on `#summary-banner`, and SHALL NOT render that attribute otherwise; the same holds for `/results/partials/content` with `HX-Request: true` and for `/results/partials/summary` (ADR-0011 point 4).
THE SYSTEM SHALL make the filter-chip, empty-state and hardware-query links of a box-number page carry `vram_gb=<n>` and no `gpu_search` (ADR-0011 point 2).

THE SYSTEM SHALL provide `tests/test_r083_box_rule.py` with each query above on `/results` and through `/results/partials/content` with `HX-Request: true`, using the real `data/` seeds (catalog `2026-10-23`).

THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, catalog validation (`python tools/validate_catalog.py --data-dir data --config tools/catalog_sources.yaml`) and `pytest` passing, with no network access and no real database (rule 19).
tasks.notes: UI: yes only through what `/results` shows; no layout change, so the existing mockups apply (`results-from-landing` for `12 GB`, `results-errors` for `0`). Rewrite the request once in `_results_page_context`; do not special-case the label, VRAM field or chips (ADR-0011 alternatives). Pass a context flag such as `box_vram` to the template. No static change, so no `ASSET_VERSION` bump. `ESTIMATION_POLICY_VERSION` unchanged (rule 16).

WHEN `#summary-banner` has no `data-box-vram`, or `#vram_gb` is absent, THE SYSTEM SHALL change no field.

tasks.title: A full page load of /results with no hardware gets a relative 302 to /
acceptance: WHEN a request to `/results` has `HX-Request` other than exactly `true` (missing, `false`, anything else) and none of `gpu_id`, `gpu_search`, `vram_gb` contains a non-whitespace character, THE SYSTEM SHALL answer `302` with `Location: /` exactly, `Cache-Control: no-cache`, a `Vary` naming both `HX-Request` and `HX-History-Restore-Request`, and no body, before any database query, ignoring every other parameter (R-013, ADR-0010 points 1 to 3).

THE SYSTEM SHALL check this in the first statement of the `results` handler through one helper (for example `_has_hardware_input`), not in a middleware, so `host_guard` runs first; the `Location` SHALL be the literal `/`, never built from `request.url` or `Host`, and the status SHALL be passed explicitly and never be 301, 307 or 308 (rule 8, ADR-0010).

WHEN tested with `follow_redirects=False`, THE SYSTEM SHALL redirect each of `/results`, `/results?context_tokens=4096&family=qwen`, `/results?gpu_search=%20%20&vram_gb=` and `/results?gpu_id=&gpu_search=&vram_gb=&context_tokens=2048`, with no header and with `HX-Request: false` (ADR-0010 guards).

WHEN `/results` carries `HX-Request: true`, THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with the fragment and the default note; with `HX-Request: true` and `HX-History-Restore-Request: true` it SHALL answer the full page (R-005, ADR-0008).
WHEN `/results?vram_gb=abc`, `/results?vram_gb=0` or `/results?gpu_id=no_such_gpu` loads, THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with results at 8 GB, and the R-008 error for the first two (Q-18).
WHEN `/results?context_tokens=abc` loads with no hardware, THE SYSTEM SHALL still answer R-008's 422 (accepted at Gate 2, 2026-10-28).
WHEN `allowed_hosts` is not `*` and `/results` is requested with `Host: evil.example.com`, THE SYSTEM SHALL answer the 400 JSON with no `Location` (rule 8, rule 18).

WHEN `/results/partials/content` is opened without `HX-Request` and with no query, THE SYSTEM SHALL still answer `302 Location: /results` byte for byte (R-081), and following both hops SHALL end on `/` with 200.
THE SYSTEM SHALL keep R-080's nine check URLs passing in `tests/test_cache_control.py` unchanged.

THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, catalog validation (`python tools/validate_catalog.py --data-dir data --config tools/catalog_sources.yaml`) and `pytest` passing, with no network access and no real database (rule 19).
tasks.notes: UI: no (shows an existing page). Opus: routing with security implications (rule 8 relative `Location`, host guard order, permanent-redirect caching). Mirror the ADR-0008 redirect in `results_partial_content` (`RedirectResponse(..., status_code=302, headers={"Cache-Control": "no-cache", "Vary": ", ".join(HTML_VARY_HEADERS)})`). Until T-028 lands, the redirect target `/` still renders today's home page; the tests here check the redirect itself, not the landing markup. No static change, no `ASSET_VERSION` bump.

acceptance: WHEN a user opens `/`, THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with `landing.html` (extends `base.html`, `main_class` `landing`), page title `VRAM Sherpa`, exactly one `h1` reading `Which local LLMs fit your GPU?`, the help line `Type a GPU name, or enter its VRAM, like 12 GB.`, and the header and footer of every page (R-083, Gate 2 copy).

THE SYSTEM SHALL render `<form id="landing-form" method="get" action="/results">` with no `hx-` attribute anywhere in `<main>`, holding a `.sr-only` `<label for="gpu_search">Search GPU</label>` and, inside `.combo`, `<input id="gpu_search" name="gpu_search" type="text" list="gpu-options" autocomplete="off" autofocus data-submit-on-choose placeholder="Your GPU, or its VRAM">`, with no `role="combobox"` in the server markup (ADR-0009 point 2, ADR-0012 points 1 and 6).

THE SYSTEM SHALL render the datalist from a new include `templates/gpu_options.html`, used by both `landing.html` and `index.html`, so `/` and `/results` emit byte-identical `<option data-gpu-id=… data-vram-gb=… value=…>` lines for all 35 GPUs in R-001's order; `/results` output SHALL otherwise be unchanged (R-001, R-071).

THE SYSTEM SHALL render exactly one `<button type="submit">` in the form whose accessible name is `Check compatibility` (an `aria-hidden` arrow SVG plus a `span.go-label` holding the words) (Q-17, Gate 2).

THE SYSTEM SHALL render under the form `<div class="launch-chips" role="group" aria-label="Examples">` with three `<a class="chip">` links and no `chip-example` class or `data-*` attribute: `RTX 4060 8GB` → `/results?gpu_id=<id>&context_tokens=2048`, `8GB` → `/results?vram_gb=8&context_tokens=2048`, `24GB` → `/results?vram_gb=24&context_tokens=2048`, built with `_example_chips` and `_results_url` (R-007, ADR-0009 point 3).

WHEN each chip's `href` is followed, THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with the hardware `NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 (8.0 GB)`, `Manual VRAM (8 GB)` and `Manual VRAM (24 GB)` respectively, `2k` selected and `Filters (0)` (R-007, R-006).

THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT render on `/`: `#summary-banner`, `#results-shell`, model cards, Top Picks, active filter chips, `details.filters`, `Apply filters`, `#vram_gb`, `#gpu_id`, any `context_tokens` input, `#clear-gpu`, any `role="alert"`, or `No GPU or VRAM selected yet. Showing estimates with an assumed 8 GB baseline.`; `<main>` SHALL contain exactly one `<input>` (R-083, R-002, R-005, R-006, Q-17).

WHEN `/` is requested with query parameters (`/?vram_gb=24&context_tokens=4096`, `/?context_tokens=abc`), THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 with the same `<main>` markup as bare `/` and no `Location` (Q-19, R-013).

THE SYSTEM SHALL make `home(request, session)` keep its signature and not call `_resolve_available_vram`, `_build_results` or `_results_context` (a test monkeypatches `_build_results` to raise and `/` still answers 200) (ADR-0009 point 4).

WHILE the catalog is unseeded, THE SYSTEM SHALL answer 200 on `/` with the box and, after the chips, a `.launch-note` holding `
` with `Catalog is not initialized yet.` and `Seed the catalog data, then refresh this page.`; the GPU chip SHALL be `Example GPU` and the two VRAM chips stay links (R-026, Q-22, Gate 2 L3).

THE SYSTEM SHALL follow the mockup structure so T-029's styles apply: `section.launch.pane` (`aria-labelledby` the `h1`), `.launch-head`, `p.launch-hint`, `.ask` wrapping `.combo` (with `svg.ask-icon`, `aria-hidden`) and `button.btn-primary.go` (R-067 L1 to L4).
THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the brand link and `Estimator` pointing to `/`, with `aria-current="page"` on `Estimator` at `/` (R-039, R-076), and `Cache-Control: no-cache` on `/` (R-080).

THE SYSTEM SHALL rewrite `test_home_returns_200` and extend `test_home_unseeded_shows_catalog_not_initialized` in `tests/test_app.py` to the landing assertions above, and put the rest in `tests/test_r083_landing.py`.

tasks.title: Release smoke test adds a /results render check that expects exactly 200 and the 24 GB summary
acceptance: THE SYSTEM SHALL add to "Smoke test the published image", after the existing `/?vram_gb=24&context_tokens=4096` request and before the asset checks, one check of `http://127.0.0.1:8000/results?vram_gb=24&context_tokens=4096` read with `curl -sS -m 10 -o <file> -w '%{http_code}'` and without `-L`/`--location`, that fails the release unless the status is exactly `200` and the body contains both `id="summary-banner"` and `Manual VRAM (24 GB)` (fixed-string match) (R-062, ADR-0013 point 2).
WHEN that check fails, THE SYSTEM SHALL print `::error::Results page did not render.` with the status and exit 1, before any tagging step (R-062, R-082 order unchanged).

THE SYSTEM SHALL keep every other line of the smoke step byte for byte, including the web command shared with `docker-compose.prod.yml`; only the old `/` check's error text may change to `Home page did not render.` (rules 18 and 20, ADR-0013 points 1 and 3).
THE SYSTEM SHALL use no new action, runner, registry, secret or permission, and SHALL NOT add `if:` or `continue-on-error` to the smoke step (rules 2 and 4).

THE SYSTEM SHALL extend `test_smoke_checks_unchanged` in `tests/test_r082_release_order.py` with the needles `/results?vram_gb=24&context_tokens=4096`, `summary-banner` and `Manual VRAM (24 GB)`, and assert that the line requesting `/results` uses neither `-L` nor `--location` (ADR-0013 point 4).
WHEN `python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/release.yml'))"` runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0; if `actionlint` is installed it SHALL report nothing.

THE SYSTEM SHALL update the "What gates a release" list in `docs/RELEASE_AND_DEPLOY.md` so "the results page renders" says `/` renders and `/results?vram_gb=24&context_tokens=4096` answers 200 with the summary for `Manual VRAM (24 GB)`; no other section changes.

THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, catalog validation (`python tools/validate_catalog.py --data-dir data --config tools/catalog_sources.yaml`) and `pytest` passing, with no network access and no real database (rule 19).
tasks.notes: UI: no. Opus: CI and deploy config. Cost: none (same job and runner; rule 2). The new check passes on today's code too (`/results?vram_gb=24…` carries hardware, so T-027's redirect does not apply). `id="summary-banner"` contains double quotes: use `grep -F` with single-quoted patterns. Write the body to a temp file (`mktemp`) and do not use `curl -f` for this check (it hides the status and passes a 3xx). QA cannot run the release locally; the real check is the first release run after merge (rule 6). Leave the other stale parts of `docs/RELEASE_AND_DEPLOY.md` (`PUBLIC_HOSTNAME`) alone; they are separate follow-ups in `.sdlc/STATUS.md`.
